editionLabel: Renegade English rulebook, 2023 copyright, with solo mode
location: How to Play opening paragraph; Solo Mode setup and Activating Ships
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently took out the garbage goes first. Continue clockwise.
officialTieBreak: If nobody has done so, the rulebook suggests racing to the nearest bin to take out the garbage.
clarifications: This opening rule applies to multiplayer play. In solo mode, one person controls the fleet and may activate any of their ships on each turn.
uncertainty: The fallback is for nobody having taken out the garbage; the rule does not separately resolve equally recent garbage trips.
evidenceNotes: The 16-page publisher download is named JunkOrbit2; page 15 carries a 2023 copyright. The official fallback is a suggestion in parentheses, not an instruction added by this site.

location: Setup step 7 and Playing the Game
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went swimming takes the first turn. Play then proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The setup supports two to six players; its starting-player instruction does not change with player count.

location: Setup step 3; Supply, Shopping and Upgrade steps
firstPlayerRule: Give the initial quest token to the player who most recently paid cash for goods or a service.
clarifications: The first Supply step uses a shared draft: everyone chooses a card before passing the remaining cards left. The token does not give its holder the first choice of every phase.
Shopping order depends on the displays. Equal appeal is broken by total displayed price, then clockwise order from the quest-token holder. The last shop to receive a hero takes the token.
The current token holder starts the Upgrade step, followed by the other players clockwise.
evidenceNotes: Downloaded from the creators’ official Game Rules page, which links the base game and expansions separately. The visible component list identifies the 112-item-card edition; no publication year is inferred from the URL.
